errors.text_span: steigt bis auf den Wert 100 im Jahr 2020 an
errors.evidence: The blue line representing 'Äußere Sicherheit' reaches a value of approximately 98 in 2020, not 100. The line also continues to rise slowly after 2020, peaking in 2022, so stating it rises 'to' 100 in 2020 is misleading about the trend.
The purple line visually starts at approximately 70 in 2015, the same as the blue line. Describing it as 'ungefähr 68' is an inaccurate approximation.

errors.text_span: bis zu einer Spitze von exakt 160 im Jahr 2022
errors.evidence: The peak of the green line in 2022 is visibly below the 160 grid line. The use of the word 'exakt' (exactly) makes this a factual error, as the value is closer to 158.
